failure_analysis: Learned from community analysis and algorithmic autopsy. Micro-scalping for 2-3 points with premature exit on 1-minute wicks leaves 20-point runners on the table while taking repeated 4-point paper-cut losses.
lesson: ASYMMETRIC SWING RUNNER PROTOCOL: When in profit (+2.2 pts), immediately secure Stop-Loss at Breakeven (+0.25 pts). Bank 40% partial at +4.2 pts, and let the 60% runner ride to the terminal target (75%+ of range or major High/Low).
corrective_action: Never close 100% of a trade on 1-minute wicks. Protect capital via Breakeven lock, harvest cash partials, and trail runners behind M5/M15 swing pivots to capture big 15 to 30+ point expansions.

failure_analysis: Learned from top TradingView Gold institutional analysts (Moon-ForexAcademy, JJainy). Entering before trendline breakout and without dynamic support retest causes high-whip scalp stop-outs.
lesson: INSTITUTIONAL BREAKOUT & RETEST ANCHOR: High-probability Long Gold expansions require a break of descending structure followed by a shallow pullback retest into the dynamic demand floor (EMA 89/55 base or H1 Order Block).
corrective_action: Strictly enter Long only upon confirmed retest of the demand base ($4160-$4163) or confirmed volume breakout above session ceiling ($4184+). Target terminal 75%+ swing expansion.
